show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: India’s top scientist, considered a national asset, comes home after years of service only to be betrayed by his own wife and son. As family bonds shatter and power games unfold, greed threatens to turn even the nation into a watan ka sauda. Forgotten Hero serves high drama, betrayal, and ambition - making it one of the most entertaining and unmissable watches of the year.
